title: Intent-aware pager curation and autoremediation playbook
creator: Rohan Patel
description: Problem: We are experiencing high pager noise during regional capacity shifts and transient KV cache pressure. Repeated low-signal pages (timeouts, transient 5xx spikes, short-lived backlog bursts) are desensitizing on-call responders and masking real multi-region failover events. Goal: Build an intent-aware pager curation and autoremediation playbook that reduces noisy pages by ~60%, provides clear runbook steps for multi-region failover and circuit-breaker incidents, and automates safe remediation (load-shedding, routing changes, and gradational circuit tripping) for high-confidence events while preserving SLO visibility.
acceptance_criteria:
- Pager volume for known noisy signals reduced by >=60% in canary region within 2 weeks of rollout.
- True positive incident pages remain >=95% precision for high-severity pages.
- Automated remediation actions (rate limit bump, regional routing shift, temporary model fallback) successfully executed in >=90% of scripted tests.
- On-call runbook reviewed and signed off by SRE/Platform PM and two engineers.
- Dashboard widget showing pre/post noise reduction and per-route SLOs added to Console release dashboard.
design_summary:
1) Signal cartography: build a scoring pipeline that enriches alerts with context (SLO delta, request origin region, model variant, KV cache hit-rate, recent autoscale events) and computes an intent score (0-100).
2) Confidence-weighted paging: map intent score bands to paging actions: suppress (<=20), digest (21-50), Slack-only with trace links (51-74), page primary on-call (>=75).
3) Automated remediation modes: advisory (create incident draft, no action), soft-mitigate (non-disruptive ops such as increasing worker queue concurrency, raising soft throttles), hard-mitigate (trigger regional gradual load-shedding + model fallback).
4) Circuit-breaker integration: when a route crosses a sustained SLO breach window and intent_score>=80, trigger a circuit with gradual traffic ramp-down and automated notifications to downstream owners.
5) Multi-region failover play: automated traffic steering to healthy regions with canary traffic probe and rollback on error; integrate with routing policies and Dedicated capacity pools.
6) Transparency: every suppression or auto-action must create a traceable incident artifact (link to ticket/PR, reason, confidence score, metrics snapshot).
tradeoffs_and_risks:
- Risk: Over-suppression could delay detection of genuine regressions; mitigations: conservative initial thresholds, canary rollout, synthetic-driven detection parallel to suppressed pages.
- Complexity: Adding enrichment pipeline increases alert processing latency; mitigation: keep enrichment asynchronous and cache last-known context, prioritize compute-light signals.
- Ownership confusion: auto-remediation may hide root causes; mitigation: require post-action incident summaries and auto-create follow-up tasks in Linear.
- Security: automated traffic steering interacts with routing and capacity allocation; mitigation: RBAC gating for hard-mitigate actions and audit logs in Console.
implementation_plan:
Phase 0: Data collection (3 days) - wire up KV cache metrics, recent autoscale events, model variant, route SLO deltas into alert enrichment service.
Phase 1: Scoring service + UI (4 days) - lightweight service calculates intent_score and exposes decisions to Alert Router; Console UI for reviewing suppressed/digested alerts.
Phase 2: Confidence mapping + runbook templates (3 days) - implement mapping bands, create runbook templates per band and per incident class.
Phase 3: Automation hooks (5 days) - soft-mitigate APIs (queue tuning, throttle changes), hard-mitigate APIs (routing switch, model fallback) with RBAC and audit.
Phase 4: Canary (7 days) - enable for low-traffic route in eu-west and us-west, monitor SLOs and observer feedback.
Phase 5: Rollout & retrospective (4 days) - expand to more routes and run a blameless postmortem after 2 weeks.
Total estimate: ~3 weeks (matches estimate = 8 points).
runbook_outline:
1) Trigger criteria: intent_score >=75 OR sustained SLO breach (5m) with error budget drop >2%.
2) Initial triage: automated enrichment links, run automated diagnostics (KV cache heatmap, recent autoscale, top offending routes).
3) Soft mitigation steps (operator or automation): increase request queue concurrency by +10%, enable short-lived caching bypass for model downloads, clear hot-KV segments.
4) Hard mitigation steps: activate regional circuit-breaker -> call traffic-steer API with canary 10% to healthy region -> monitor latencies/SLOs for 3 minutes -> ramp to 50% if stable -> record action.
5) Post-action: create follow-up ticket with root cause hypothesis, add graphs and confidence score, schedule deep-dive.
6) Escalation: if auto-action fails or SLOs worsen, page SRE primary and on-call lead.
automation_tasks:
- Alert enrichment microservice (alerts-enricher) PR: github.com/redwood-inference/alerts-enricher/pull/325
- Alert Router mapping update to consume intent_score and enforce paging bands (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/alert-router/pull/612)
- Soft-mitigate API implementation in runtime-control (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime-control/pull/209)
- Traffic-steer + canary runner in infra-orchestrator (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra-orchestrator/pull/104)
- Console UI: suppressed alerts queue and review flow (Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/intent-aware-pager-ui)
- Add dashboard panels: /dashboards/reliability/intent-paging-prepost
- Test harness: scripted chaos tests to exercise KV pressure and simulate region cutover (repo: github.com/redwood-inference/chaos-tests).
testing_and_validation:
- Unit tests for scoring function and mapping rules.
- Integration test that simulates KV cache pressure and verifies suppression band and soft-mitigate actions.
- Chaos test that simulates region flakiness and verifies canary traffic-steer + rollback.
- Observability validation: ensure traces and audit logs are emitted for every suppression and auto-action.
- Runbook tabletop exercise with 3 SREs and 1 PM to validate clarity and timing.
dashboards_and_alerts:
- New dashboard: Intent Paging Summary (panels: suppressed vs paged volume, SLO delta for suppressed alerts, automation success rate).
- Alerts: send automated telemetry if suppressed_alerts/total_alerts > 0.8 for >12h (indicates misconfiguration).
- Add tracing hook to incident timeline: each automated action must emit a trace_id and Console must be able to jump to the associated ticket.
rollout_and_monitoring:
- Canary region: eu-west-1 and us-west-2 on low-traffic routes for 7 days.
- Daily review during canary with metrics: page volume, SLO deltas, automation success/failure, false-suppression rate.
- Stop criteria: any increase in high-severity SLO breaches or more than 3 missed real incidents during canary window.
- After 2 weeks, run a blameless retrospective and adjust thresholds.
